title: Calder Deep
text: Calder Deep is a mine with no surface. No company of that name ever filed a claim, paid a tax or buried a miner, yet its fortieth level sits kilometers below the deepest mine on record: timbered, railed, carts loaded, a lift cage hanging on a taut cable. The coolant drums by the pump station match your own supplier's spec, and their delivery dates have not happened yet. The call bell in the cage still works. The shaft below the fortieth level has never been measured. Crews who try do not report a depth.
teaser: A mine with no surface, and a bell that still rings.
